method.rank_overlap: Actual earnings-tercile probability intervals overlapped with B15 discrete z-state rank intervals; within each empirical tercile, actual conditional omega-quintile probabilities distribute the overlap. Both empirical node and B15 z marginals are preserved exactly.
method.wealth_scale: b_model = omega * actual frozen working-age mean annual gross earnings. Actual serialized seed and both utility bindings inspected without solving; native income and analytic stationary age weights agree with saved B lifecycle.
method.cash_only_resource_sign: R_gross*b + Y_age18 <= 0 retained only as a descriptive cash-only statistic; withdrawn as a feasibility or necessary-resource test because age-18 unsecured debt rollover is allowed. See renter_slack_correction.json for source-traced renter-floor gate.
method.return: Actual inherited R_gross=1.02^4; source defaults differ and are not used; no equilibrium solve.
method.grid_support: Compared exact scaled node values with selected B wealth-grid min/max; no clipping, censoring, or interpolation.

model_working_age_scale.z_weights_source: Frozen B15 distribution; invariant mean z preserved by rank overlap coupling.

empirical_comparison.age_sample_note: PSID childless-renter family-years ages18-24; mapped model is age-18 entrant distribution.

working_age_mass_source.source: Saved selected B seven-state native_lifecycle_2023.csv, 12 working age cells, used only for age weights; all masses equal to numerical precision.
working_age_mass_source.why_usable_for_illustrative_mapping: Actual inherited survival is enabled, equals one through working ages, and declines in retirement. B15 analytic age masses computed from actual P equal the saved B07 working masses; no source-default survival assumption is used.
working_age_mass_source.resolution_limit: No B15 stationary equilibrium/checkpoint was solved or validated; this uses the common demographic timing/profile and is a unit mapping only.

discretization.interpretation: Product-within-tercile mapping can assign probability to omega-quintile/z-rank combinations with zero support in the finer microdata rank-overlap table.
